description: This file provides functionality for performing regex searches on files using ripgrep within a VSCode extension environment. It includes functions to locate the ripgrep binary, execute searches, parse results, and format output, with key components like getBinPath, execRipgrep, and regexSearchFiles.

methods.name: truncateLine
methods.description: Truncates a line if it exceeds the maximum length, appending '[truncated...]' if necessary.

methods.name: getBinPath
methods.description: Locates the ripgrep binary within the VSCode installation directories or via checkBunPath.

methods.name: execRipgrep
methods.description: Executes the ripgrep command with specified arguments, captures output, and handles errors.

methods.name: regexSearchFiles
methods.description: Performs regex search on files in a directory, parses ripgrep JSON output, filters results, and formats the output string.

methods.name: formatResults
methods.description: Formats parsed ripgrep results into a readable string with file grouping and line context.
